office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Ferry County's Superior and District Courts and advises the county's commissioners and officials.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Michael Golden, the office's only attorney since November 2024 and a Ferry County lawyer since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Ferry County Prosecuting Attorney since November 2024; a former deputy prosecutor and defense attorney in the county since 2011.
highlights: Prosecuting Attorney since November 2024 and the office's only attorney [S1]
Deputy prosecutor and defense attorney in Ferry County since 2011 [S1]
Emphasizes victims' rights and holding defendants accountable [S1]
